waive.llms: llms.txt is written by hand in content/llms.txt and edited through Carrel, not built from a page list
waive.health: /api/health runs five checks (D1, R2, AI Search, the backup, the limiter) and records a snapshot for the drift repair; healthResponse is the one-database case

copies.workers/security-headers.mjs: the site's ratified overrides to buildSecurityHeaders, which it calls; the header names are keys, not a second builder
copies.scripts/lib/headers/static-set-and-cache: the gate's hand-transcribed ratified set, compared against what the Worker sends
